# Sayerli

> Sayerli is a B2B SaaS platform built specifically for Moroccan freelancers, auto-entrepreneurs, and SMEs (PMEs). It replaces Excel and paper with a modern, cloud-based tool to manage clients, quotes, invoices, delivery orders, payments, and expenses — in French, Arabic (RTL), and English, priced in MAD (Moroccan dirhams).

**Tagline:** "Nta khdem, Sayerli ysayyer lik lba9i" — You work, Sayerli handles the rest.

**Website:** https://sayerli.com
**Register (free):** https://sayerli.com/register

---

## What Sayerli Does

### Core Documents
- **Devis (Quotes)** — Create professional quotes with line items, discounts, and TVA. Send via email or share a public link. Clients accept or reject directly from a portal, no account needed. Supports electronic signature (owner + client).
- **Factures (Invoices)** — Generate invoices compliant with Moroccan law (mentions obligatoires, numérotation séquentielle). Send by email, track payment status (BROUILLON, ENVOYÉE, PARTIELLEMENT_PAYÉE, PAYÉE, EN_RETARD, ANNULÉE). Convert a quote to an invoice in one click.
- **Bons de livraison (Delivery Notes / BL)** — Create delivery notes linked to orders, with owner e-signature.
- **Reçu de paiement (Payment Receipts)** — Auto-generated PDF receipt sent to client on payment approval.

### Client Management (CRM)
- Client profiles with contact info, company type (ENTREPRISE / FREELANCE / PARTICULIER), ICE, IF Fiscal
- Client portal: each client has a unique public link to view their quotes and invoices
- Full commercial history per client

### Payments
- Record payments: cash, bank transfer, check, card, mobile money
- Track outstanding balances per invoice and per client
- Payment declaration workflow: client declares payment, owner approves or rejects
- Automatic overdue detection (EN_RETARD status)

### Automation
- **Relances automatiques** — Daily cron at 08:00 Casablanca time sends reminder emails for overdue invoices (configurable per plan)
- **Email notifications** — New quote accepted, invoice viewed, payment received, overdue alert

### Analytics & Reporting
- Dashboard with KPI cards: CA total, CA en attente, taux de recouvrement
- Top 5 clients by revenue (bar chart)
- Overdue invoices list with inline "Relancer" action
- **Journal des Ventes** — Export all invoices to Excel with: date, number, client, ICE, IF Fiscal, HT, TVA, TTC, paid, remaining, status
- Expenses management with receipt uploads and storage

### Team Management
- Multi-user per company with roles: ADMIN, MANAGER, COMMERCIAL, COMPTABLE
- Activity log for all team actions
- Invite members by email

### Catalogue
- Product and service catalogue with name, description, price, unit, type (PRODUIT / SERVICE)
- Insert catalogue items directly into quotes

### Settings & Branding
- Company profile: logo, address, ICE, RC, bank info (RIB, IBAN, SWIFT)
- E-signature pad for owner signature on all documents
- Custom invoice/quote/BL numbering prefix and starting number
- DGI / Facturation Électronique tab (Simpl-TVA integration — Morocco)
- Language selector: French, Arabic (RTL), English
- Dark/light theme

---

## Who It's For

- **Freelancers au Maroc** — Developers, designers, consultants, translators, photographers
- **Auto-entrepreneurs au Maroc** — Registered under the auto-entrepreneur regime (régime IR libératoire)
- **PMEs marocaines** — Small and medium Moroccan businesses (commerce, services, artisanat)
- **Agences** — Marketing, communication, digital agencies
- **Comptables** — As a read-only external viewer for their clients' data (coming soon)

All plans: no credit card required for Starter. Pay in MAD. Upgrade via WhatsApp.

---

## Key Differentiators vs Competitors

- **Built for Morocco** — Not adapted from a Western product. Native MAD, TVA marocaine (7%, 10%, 14%, 20%), ICE/IF Fiscal fields, DGI compliance
- **Arabic RTL** — Full interface in Arabic with right-to-left layout
- **Client portal** — No competitor offers a free branded client portal where clients sign quotes and view invoices
- **E-signature** — Both owner and client can sign quotes electronically
- **Auto-entrepreneur friendly** — Specific fields and workflows for the Moroccan auto-entrepreneur regime
- **Simple** — No accountant required. Operational in under 5 minutes

---

## Technical

- Hosted: Vercel (frontend), Railway (backend)
- Compliant with Moroccan invoicing law
- Data stored in Morocco-region-adjacent infrastructure (Neon PostgreSQL, Cloudflare R2)
- JWT auth, multi-tenant (each company's data is fully isolated)
